newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Co-Nexus ousted from stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Co-Nexus ousted from stock exchange.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange's council said on Wednesday it had decided to terminate the bourse membership of Co-Nexus Rt, effective March 10.
The council also decided to admit Kiralybroker Kft as a new member securities house, effective March 11, the BSE said in a statement.
In February Hungary's State Money and Capital Market Supervision (APTF) extended a prevention on Co-Nexus from securities trading and fund management until the end of March.
The original suspension, imposed in November due to breaching legal regulations, expired on January 31.
